cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen opens with all captions and the entry prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator is signed on and selects Password Change from the main menu (first entry, communication area present).
cases.steps:
1. From the main menu, select Password Change (transaction ORPW)
2. Observe the opening screen
cases.expected: The Password Change screen is shown with the title and the captions `Tran:`, `Date:`, `Pgm :`, `Time:`, `User ID :`, `Old Pass:`, `New Pass:`, `Confirm :`, the footer `ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear`, all four entry fields empty, and the message line showing `Enter user id, old and new password.`
cases.remark: §2.1 MPWDCHA mockup; 1000-SEND-INITIAL L46-51; BMS MPWDCH.bms; msg M1

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Entry fields are enterable; header and message line are display-only
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Password Change screen is open (initial display).
cases.steps:
1. Move the cursor across the screen fields
2. Try to place the cursor in each field and type
cases.expected: The four fields User ID, Old Pass, New Pass and Confirm accept input (unprotected, green); the header fields (Tran/Date/Pgm/Time), the title and the message line are display-only and reject input; initial cursor is on User ID.
cases.remark: §2.1 item states; BMS attrs UNPROT/IC/FSET (entry) vs ASKIP/NORM (display); USERID has IC

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Header shows transaction, program, current date and time in the expected format
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Password Change screen is open.
cases.steps: 1. Read the header line values on the opening screen
cases.expected: Tran shows `ORPW`, Pgm shows `OCPWDCH`, Date shows the current date as year-month-day (e.g. `2026-09-28`) and Time shows the current time as hours:minutes:seconds (e.g. `14:30:05`).
cases.remark: 8000-POPULATE-HEADER L118-128; FORMATTIME DATESEP('-') YYYYMMDD, TIME TIMESEP(':') HH:MM:SS; WS-TRANID/WS-PGMNAME

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Entered passwords are displayed in clear text (no masking)
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Password Change screen is open.
cases.steps:
1. Type `PASS0002` in Old Pass
2. Type `NEWPW01` in New Pass and Confirm
3. Observe the fields
cases.expected: The typed characters are visible on screen as entered — the password fields are not masked (no non-display attribute).
cases.remark: BMS OLDPWD/NEWPWD/CFMPWD = UNPROT,IC,FSET,GREEN with no DRK; grounded finding (see NOTES §2)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Change a normal user's password successfully
cases.precondition: F-STD. User `USER0001` exists with current password `PASS0002`. Password Change screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0001`
2. Enter Old Pass `PASS0002`
3. Enter New Pass `NEWPW01` and Confirm `NEWPW01`
4. Press ENTER
cases.data: User ID=`USER0001`, Old Pass=`PASS0002`, New Pass=`NEWPW01`, Confirm=`NEWPW01`
cases.expected: The message line shows `Password changed successfully.`; the stored password for `USER0001` is updated to `NEWPW01`; the screen stays on Password Change.
cases.remark: 2100-CHANGE-PWD → 4000-UPDATE-PWD REWRITE FILE(USRSEC) L107-116; msg M4; US-PASSWORD; UC main flow

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Change the admin user's password successfully (no type-based difference)
cases.precondition: F-STD. User `ADMIN001` (type A, admin) exists with current password `PASS0001`. Password Change screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `ADMIN001`
2. Enter Old Pass `PASS0001`
3. Enter New Pass `ADMPW001` and Confirm `ADMPW001`
4. Press ENTER
cases.data: User ID=`ADMIN001`, Old Pass=`PASS0001`, New Pass=`ADMPW001`, Confirm=`ADMPW001`
cases.expected: The message line shows `Password changed successfully.`; the stored password for `ADMIN001` is updated to `ADMPW001`. The flow is identical for admin and normal users (the program does not branch on user type).
cases.remark: US-TYPE 'A' record; program never reads US-TYPE; 4000 REWRITE; msg M4

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: An operator changes a different user's password (no per-user restriction)
cases.precondition: F-STD. Operator is signed on as `USER0001` but keys a different user. Target `USER0002` current password `PASS0003`. Screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0002` (not the signed-on user)
2. Enter Old Pass `PASS0003`
3. Enter New Pass `NEWPW02` and Confirm `NEWPW02`
4. Press ENTER
cases.data: Signed-on=`USER0001`; User ID keyed=`USER0002`, Old Pass=`PASS0003`, New Pass=`NEWPW02`
cases.expected: The message line shows `Password changed successfully.`; `USER0002`'s stored password is updated to `NEWPW02`. The program applies no per-user restriction — the record changed is the one keyed in User ID, not the signed-on user.
cases.remark: CA-USER-ID never compared to USERIDI; grounded finding (NOTES §2); RIDFLD(US-ID)=USERIDI

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: ENTER processes the current entry
cases.precondition: F-STD. Screen open with a complete, valid entry for `USER0001` (Old `PASS0002`, New/Confirm `NEWPW01`).
cases.steps:
1. Fill User ID `USER0001`, Old Pass `PASS0002`, New Pass `NEWPW01`, Confirm `NEWPW01`
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: ENTER triggers validation and the password change; the message line shows `Password changed successfully.` (ENTER is the process key).
cases.remark: 2000 EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHENTER → 2100-CHANGE-PWD L62-63; key from §1.2

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the main menu carrying the shared context
cases.precondition: F-STD. Password Change screen open (re-entry).
cases.steps: 1. Press PF3
cases.expected: The transaction cancels and control returns to the main menu (OCMENU); the shared communication area is passed on so the menu keeps the session context.
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHPF3 → XCTL PROGRAM(OCMENU) COMMAREA(ORION-COMMAREA) L55-59; CA-PGM-CONTEXT set 0

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entered values and restarts the screen
cases.precondition: F-STD. Screen open with values typed in User ID / Old / New / Confirm.
cases.steps:
1. Type any values in the four fields
2. Press PF4
cases.data: e.g. User ID=`USER0001`, Old Pass=`PASS0002`, New/Confirm=`NEWPW01`
cases.expected: All entered values are cleared and the initial screen is redisplayed with the prompt `Enter user id, old and new password.`; the operator can start again.
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL L60-61 (LOW-VALUES + msg M1)

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: Unsupported key is rejected with a message
cases.precondition: F-STD. Password Change screen open (re-entry).
cases.steps: 1. Press an unsupported key (e.g. PF12)
cases.data: AID = PF12 (any key other than ENTER/PF3/PF4)
cases.expected: The screen is redisplayed with the fields cleared and the message line shows `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.`; no file is read or updated.
cases.remark: 2000 EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN OTHER L64-67; WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY; msg M6

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Cold start with no context bounces to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The transaction ORPW is started directly, with no communication area (no menu context).
cases.steps: 1. Start transaction ORPW with no communication area (e.g. typed directly)
cases.expected: The Password Change screen is not shown; control transfers straight to the main menu (OCMENU).
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN IF EIBCALEN=0 → XCTL PROGRAM(OCMENU) L33-36 (no commarea)

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Pseudo-conversational re-entry: first send then process on next key
cases.precondition: F-STD. Reached from the menu with context = first entry.
cases.steps:
1. Enter the screen from the menu (first entry)
2. Observe the initial send
3. Press any supported key
cases.expected: On first entry the screen is sent with the prompt `Enter user id, old and new password.` and the transaction returns pending on ORPW; on the next key press the input is processed (first-entry vs re-entry are distinguished by the saved context flag).
cases.remark: CA-PGM-CONTEXT 0→1 (CA-FIRST-ENTER/CA-RE-ENTER); 1000 L51; 9000 RETURN TRANSID(ORPW) L136-137

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: New password persists; old one no longer works after change
cases.precondition: F-STD. `USER0001` password just changed to `NEWPW01` (via IT_PWDCHG_HAPPY_005).
cases.steps:
1. On the screen, enter User ID `USER0001`, Old Pass `NEWPW01`, New Pass `NEWPW03`, Confirm `NEWPW03`, press ENTER
2. Then enter User ID `USER0001`, Old Pass `PASS0002` (the original), New/Confirm `X1`, press ENTER
cases.expected: Step 1 shows `Password changed successfully.` (the new password is accepted as the current one). Step 2 shows `Current password is incorrect.` (the original password `PASS0002` no longer matches) — confirming the change was persisted.
cases.remark: 4000 REWRITE persists US-PASSWORD; re-change idempotence; msg M4 then M3

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: User ID left blank is rejected as a required field
cases.precondition: F-STD. Password Change screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Leave User ID blank
2. Enter Old Pass `PASS0002`, New Pass `NEWPW01`, Confirm `NEWPW01`
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The message line shows `Please enter all required fields.`; no file read or update occurs.
cases.remark: 2100 IF USERIDI=SPACES OR LOW-VALUES L73-75; WS-MSG-REQUIRED; msg M7 (only User ID is checked for blank)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: New password and confirmation do not match
cases.precondition: F-STD. `USER0001` exists with current password `PASS0002`. Screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0001`, Old Pass `PASS0002`
2. Enter New Pass `NEWPW01` and Confirm `NEWPW02` (different)
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The message line shows `New password and confirm do not match.`; no update occurs (the check runs before the user record is read).
cases.remark: 2100 IF NEWPWDI NOT = CFMPWDI L77-80; msg M2; runs before 3000-READ-USER

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Unknown user id is not found
cases.precondition: F-STD. No user `ZZZZ9999` exists in the user-security file.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `ZZZZ9999`
2. Enter Old Pass `PASS0002`, New Pass `NEWPW01`, Confirm `NEWPW01`
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The message line shows `Record not found.`; no update occurs.
cases.remark: 3000-READ-USER READ FILE(USRSEC) RIDFLD(US-ID) → REC-NOT-FOUND L84-86; WS-MSG-NOTFND; msg M8

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Current password is incorrect
cases.precondition: F-STD. `USER0001` exists with current password `PASS0002`. Screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0001`
2. Enter Old Pass `WRONGPWD` (not the stored password)
3. Enter New Pass `NEWPW01`, Confirm `NEWPW01`
4. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The message line shows `Current password is incorrect.`; the stored password is unchanged.
cases.remark: 2100 IF US-PASSWORD NOT = OLDPWDI L88-91; msg M3; protects data integrity

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Only User ID is required — blank Old Pass still proceeds to the wrong-password check
cases.precondition: F-STD. `USER0001` exists with current password `PASS0002`. Screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0001`
2. Leave Old Pass, New Pass and Confirm all blank
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: User ID=`USER0001`; Old Pass=blank; New Pass=blank; Confirm=blank
cases.expected: The required-field check passes (only User ID is validated for blank), New equals Confirm (both blank), the user is read, and because the blank Old Pass does not match the stored `PASS0002` the message line shows `Current password is incorrect.`; no update occurs.
cases.remark: Quirk: 2100 checks only USERIDI blank (L73); Old/New/Confirm blank not rejected; falls through to L88 compare; msg M3

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Password update fails on a file error
cases.precondition: F-STD. `USER0001` exists (Old `PASS0002`). The user-security file update is forced to fail (e.g. file made unavailable / rewrite returns a non-normal response). *(needs fault injection)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0001`, Old Pass `PASS0002`, New Pass `NEWPW01`, Confirm `NEWPW01`
2. Press ENTER (with the file update failing)
cases.data: Valid entry; update forced to return a non-normal response
cases.expected: The message line shows `Password change failed.`; the stored password remains `PASS0002` (unchanged).
cases.remark: 4000-UPDATE-PWD REWRITE non-normal RESP branch L111-115; msg M5; runtime/environment fault class

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Blank new password is accepted and stored as spaces
cases.precondition: F-STD. `USER0001` exists with current password `PASS0002`. Screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0001`, Old Pass `PASS0002`
2. Leave New Pass and Confirm both blank
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: New Pass=blank, Confirm=blank (both empty), Old Pass=`PASS0002`
cases.expected: New equals Confirm (both blank), the old password matches, and the change succeeds: `Password changed successfully.` — the stored password for `USER0001` is set to spaces (there is no minimum-length / non-blank rule on the new password).
cases.remark: 4000 MOVE NEWPWDI(blank) TO US-PASSWORD L108; no min-length check; grounded edge (NOTES §2); msg M4

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: New password at the maximum field length (8 characters)
cases.precondition: F-STD. `USER0001` exists with current password `PASS0002`. Screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0001`, Old Pass `PASS0002`
2. Enter New Pass `PW345678` (8 characters) and Confirm `PW345678`
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The 8-character new password is accepted; `Password changed successfully.`; the stored password is `PW345678`.
cases.remark: NEWPWD/US-PASSWORD PIC X(08); BMS NEWPWD LENGTH=8 (max)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: New password of a single character
cases.precondition: F-STD. `USER0001` exists with current password `PASS0002`. Screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0001`, Old Pass `PASS0002`
2. Enter New Pass `X` (1 character) and Confirm `X`
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The single-character new password is accepted; `Password changed successfully.`; the stored password is `X` (no minimum-length rule).
cases.remark: No min-length check in 2100/4000; NEWPWD PIC X(08) padded with spaces

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Entry fields cannot exceed 8 characters
cases.precondition: F-STD. Password Change screen open.
cases.steps: 1. Attempt to type 9 characters (e.g. `ABCDEFGHI`) into the New Pass field
cases.data: Attempted input=`ABCDEFGHI` (9 chars) into an 8-char field
cases.expected: The field accepts at most 8 characters (`ABCDEFGH`); the 9th character is not accepted (the map field length is 8).
cases.remark: BMS NEWPWD LENGTH=8; symbolic NEWPWDI PIC X(08); max+1 prevented by the map

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Old-password comparison is case-sensitive
cases.precondition: F-STD. `USER0001` exists with current password `PASS0002` (upper case). Screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter User ID `USER0001`
2. Enter Old Pass `pass0002` (correct value, lower case)
3. Enter New Pass `NEWPW01`, Confirm `NEWPW01`
4. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The message line shows `Current password is incorrect.` — the comparison is an exact byte match, so a case difference fails; no update occurs.
cases.remark: 2100 IF US-PASSWORD NOT = OLDPWDI L88 (exact X(08) compare); msg M3
